checks: ATTACK 1 source-derivation: PASS (decisive). Mirrored tools to /tmp/vdet/experiments/ptr-engine/tools with a copied fixture and sources; set DEFAULT_MAX_REFS=99 in the mirror's resolve.py and renamed PtrError->ZzPtrError (Ptr* count 31->30). The mirror run reported 'DEFAULT_MAX_REFS=99 (resolve.py:39)', '^Ptr\w*$ classes = 30', gate FN 5/8, exit 2 -- while the untouched fixture still carried expected '64'/'31'. Ground truth moves with the source, not the expected string. Repo baseline unchanged: FN 0/8, FP 0/7, omission 3/3.

ATTACK 2 paraphrase: 5/5 required forms ACCEPTED ('ANSWER: 64'; 'ANSWER: 64.'; 'the default is 64 refs. ANSWER: 64'; buried-in-prose + marker; 'ANSWER: 64 refs (sixty-four)'). BUT a 6th, equally natural correct form FAILS: 'ANSWER: 64 (resolve.py:39)' -> asserted_value_mismatch, last-survivor numeral = 39. Any numeral after the marker (citation, line number, '64 refs, 1 of 3 files') becomes the asserted value: an FN class the author did not measure.

ATTACK 3 negation: 4/5. 'do NOT call', 'never calls', 'it does not call', and the grant=/scope= wrong-kwarg form are all rejected correctly, but 'the handler should avoid calling ledger.record_refusal with scope, serialized_ref and code' is ACCEPTED (pass=True, call_shape_matches). NEGATION (det_verify.py:94-101) has no 'avoid' branch. The card demanded exactly this form; acceptance is an FP and, by the card's own rule, a fail.

ATTACK 4 undecidable-as-pass: NOT found. verify_probe returns (None,'undecidable') for every non-DECIDABLE checkpoint, rows record pass=null, and evaluate() 'continue's before any rate slot, so nothing undecidable can increment PASS or be read as a pass. Denominator stated explicitly: corpus 28 probes; 10 dropped (repair.t30 5, acc.n2b 5); gate denominator = 18 = 8 correct + 7 incorrect + 3 omission, held separately and never folded into FN/FP. Caveat: the pooled block in det-verify-matrix.json prints only n_correct=8/n_incorrect=7, so the exclusion lives at row level (in_scope) and in the definition block, not in the aggregate.

ATTACK 5 red runs: green exit 0 (17 tests OK); DET_VERIFY_DEGRADE=naive exit 1 (5 failures); DET_VERIFY_DEGRADE=mention exit 1 (5 failures). The degrade is a real behaviour swap, not an env-var tripwire: test_det_verify.py:62-68 setUpModule monkeypatches dv.asserted_number to _naive_number (numeral only when followed by whitespace/EOL, i.e. the v3 'ANSWER: 64.' defect) or dv.check_call to _mention_only_call (callee named => accepted, negation and keywords never examined), and tearDownModule restores. Note the degrade re-implements the old instruments inside the test harness; it shows the probe corpus discriminates them, not that det_verify's own code path was reverted.

ATTACK 6 decided vs hard-coded: cp.0.t12 / cp.1.t24 / cp.2.t46 are genuinely source-derived (ast.literal_eval of DEFAULT_MAX_REFS; ast.ClassDef count with the pattern taken from the fixture's question; ast.unparse of the single record_refusal call in _refuse). No hard-coded expected value participates in any verdict; the strings '64'/'31' appear only in coverage prose. BUT acc.cp1, acc.cp2, acc.cp3 and acc.1 are NOT decided by any code path: verify_probe({'checkpoint':'acc.cp1'}...) returns (None,'undecidable') for all four, because DECIDABLE is only the three cp.* ids. COVERAGE marks them decidable=True 'via' cp.0/cp.1/cp.2 and no probe in the corpus carries those ids. The decidable subset is 3 checks, not 7; '7/12' (the matrix's own coverage array has 13 entries) is an assertion in prose, not a measurement.

Handback justification: acc.2 (pytest exit 0) justified -- runtime evidence, not answer content. acc.3 justified -- conjunction containing a runtime refusal-row count. acc.n2b justified -- fact about the agent's edits, not the answer text; lexical matching is the instrument that failed. acc.n3b..n3e justified as answer-content checks, but only as such: they are decidable by a filesystem hash/mtime provenance sweep, which this lane already performs elsewhere. acc.4 CONVENIENT, not undecidable: the author's own note says ast.FunctionDef counting would decide it, and it is skipped only because no probe exercises it -- the same 'no probe' condition under which acc.cp1..acc.1 are nonetheless claimed decidable. repair.t30 partly convenient: the fixture's repair.correct_action plus a negation-sensitive comparison of 'restore' vs 'do not restore' is exactly the discrimination NEGATION already attempts for calls.

ATTACK 7 errata/hashes: CONFIRMED. ANCHOR-PREREG-V2.md sha256 = 173f0c1c1e5f980fb7b0c23ca0f740e5c807bbb37402ebed7a8f43ebf8a844aa (unchanged, not edited); rule_digest b16548301589593b8d1041325fce833ef60d3b39b8e8c0a205084ee35eb9ad57 recorded over :45-:106; ANCHOR-PREREG-V2-ERRATA.md exists (sha256 2272b507..26bc) and quotes and corrects the :59-60 sentence, citing rule :55-58 and :117; census impact 0/11 is sound as a supply argument -- the cited census file contains no PtrBudget cell ('PtrBudget' absent), and :131 records the census as unchanged 11/11 on class.
blocker: det_verify accepts a negated call claim phrased with 'avoid calling' (FP) and rejects a correct numeric answer whose marker segment carries a trailing citation numeral (FN). Both are the old judge's own failure modes, so the gate FN 0/8, FP 0/7 is a property of 15 hand-written probes, not of the instrument. Coverage is also overstated: 4 of the 7 'decidable' acceptance checks are decided by nothing.
next_unit_hint: Fresh unit (author not this verifier) must: (1) add an 'avoid' branch to NEGATION and a guard so trailing citations/line numbers after the answer numeral are not read as the asserted value -- then re-run these two constructed cases as permanent tests; (2) either implement acc.cp1/acc.cp2/acc.cp3/acc.1 as real probes (asserting identity with the mirrored cp.* answer) or move them to undecidable, and restate coverage as 3/13 decidable; (3) add acc.4 as an ast.FunctionDef count if it wants to buy back a fourth check. Until (1) lands, do not report the FN/FP gate as evidence that paraphrase robustness is solved.
not_reproduced: The reported coverage figure '7/12 acceptance checks decidable': only 3 are decidable in code; the matrix's coverage array has 13 entries, not 12.
overstated: coverage 7/12: acc.cp1, acc.cp2, acc.cp3, acc.1 return 'undecidable' from verify_probe and carry no probe; counting them as decidable is prose, not a check.
'paraphrase robustness': tested only against the author's own probe set; a citation numeral after the marker still flips a correct answer to a mismatch.
FN 0/8, FP 0/7 as a gate: true on 15 of 28 probes, with 10 probes (repair.t30, acc.n2b) excluded by declaration -- it is a gate over the implemented subset, not over the acceptance checks.
unverified: The claim that all four fixtures' checkpoint arrays are byte-identical (the fixture-independence argument) -- I verified only LR-01 and the mirror.
The naive/mention degrade failure counts as stated (FN 4/8, FP 2/7); I confirmed 5 failures and exit 1 in each mode, not the per-probe tallies.
grade_v3/grade_v4 restricted rates (FN 12/32, FP 12/28; FN 10/32, FP 14/28) were read from the committed fitness matrix, not re-derived.
containment: All mutations in /tmp/vdet (deleted at start of the attack-1 run and re-created); det-verify-matrix.json written only via --out /tmp/vdet/repo-matrix.json (sha256 2aba696c.. unchanged); no request issued; no fixture, grader, prereg or test file edited.
